parameters.query:
SELECT
  product_id,
  COUNT(*) AS high_risk_stores,
  ROUND(AVG(predicted_sales)::numeric, 2) AS avg_predicted_sales,
  ROUND(AVG(recommended_reorder_qty)::numeric, 1) AS avg_reorder_qty,
  MAX(replenishment_priority) AS replenishment_priority
FROM ml.forecast_recommendations
WHERE stockout_risk = 'HIGH'
  AND replenishment_priority = 'HIGH'
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY high_risk_stores DESC, avg_predicted_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;
